missing_value_policy.notes: 未知數值不使用 0。原表的 - / -- 保留在 raw_value；raw 表格 rows 的 null 可能是合併格延續或抽取缺漏。

review_status_definitions.source_checked: 正規化資料或摘要已與指定型錄對照；仍保留來源以供後續核對。
review_status_definitions.needs_review: 自動擷取、未重建的圖表、待核對值或人工尚未完成逐格核對。
review_status_definitions.text_index_only: 僅表示此識別字出現在來源；不代表已確認的標準品或庫存。

notes: 全型錄可見文字及264張表格已保留；圖面和圖示沒有完整轉成數值。
items 正規化範圍為 ACE、NC Helix、部分 NineBore 與延長桿；其他系列請由 tables / pages / identifier_index 查詢，後續可繼續新增。
cutting_data 正規化範圍為 ACE 與 NC Helix；其他切削表在 tables 中保留。
沒有混入本專案較新版官網或郵件資料。

metadata.extension_policy: 新增產品/型號/來源採追加記錄並使用新 id；既有 id 不因排序或改名而改動；自訂欄位放 extensions。

product_families.description_en: Indexable spotting tool with symmetric two-flute edges and dual point angles.
features_en: Symmetric two-flute edge design reduces lateral force.
Internal coolant and minimum quantity lubrication (MQL) capability.
No tool length resetting by insert type.
product_families.notes: 繁體中文名稱為整理譯名，非型錄原文。

product_families.description_en: Micro spotting geometries guide a micro drill towards the hole center line.
features_en: One holder supports the entire X060 insert series.
applications_en: Spotting on round, angled or curved surfaces
product_families.notes: 繁體中文名稱為整理譯名，非型錄原文。

product_families.description_en: Indexable spot drill system with interchangeable inserts for multiple applications.
features_en: Various inserts fit on the same tool holder.
product_families.notes: 繁體中文名稱為整理譯名，非型錄原文。

product_families.description_en: Corner rounding inserts with radii from 0.5 to 10 mm use NC Spot Drill basic holders.
features_en: Small X offset for contour chamfering.
product_families.notes: 繁體中文名稱為整理譯名，非型錄原文。

product_families.description_en: Front and back corner rounding system using interchangeable radius inserts from R1.0 to R3.0.
features_en: R1.0 to R3.0 inserts are interchangeable on the same holder.
CNC-ground inserts provide precision radius and location.
product_families.notes: 繁體中文名稱為整理譯名，非型錄原文。

product_families.description_en: 45° chamfering insert and holders for front/back chamfering applications.
product_families.notes: 繁體中文名稱為整理譯名，非型錄原文。

product_families.description_en: Indexable center drill system with two cutting flutes and internal coolant to the insert tip.
features_en: Two cutting flutes and two cutting edges per insert.
Constant drilling depth when changing insert or cutting edge.
Internal coolant can be supplied to the tip.

series.notes: Accessory for aligning work-spindle and tool centers; not a cutting insert.

series.name_en: Ergo IC10 center drilling, spotting and countersinking

product_families.notes: 繁體中文名稱為整理譯名，非型錄原文。

product_families.description_en: Sleeve system for adjusting the center height of cutting tools on CNC lathes.
applications_en: Adjusting center height of center drills, NC spot drills, reamers and taps
product_families.notes: 繁體中文名稱為整理譯名，非型錄原文。

product_families.description_en: Indexable engraving system with radius-angled and radius-form inserts.
features_en: One holder supports the entire X060 insert series.
No tool length resetting after changing insert or cutting edge.
applications_en: Engraving serial numbers, product codes, dial scales, signs, logos and characters
product_families.notes: 繁體中文名稱為整理譯名，非型錄原文。

product_families.description_en: 45° and 60° indexable engraving tools with application-specific insert geometries and grades.
features_en: Carbide shank holders for high-speed cutting.
Starter kits available for V045 and V060.
product_families.notes: 繁體中文名稱為整理譯名，非型錄原文。

product_families.description_en: Slim 60° engraving system for thin or light engraving on engraving machines.
product_families.notes: 繁體中文名稱為整理譯名，非型錄原文。

product_families.description_en: 60° and 90° engraving inserts using the NC Spot Drill basic holder.
features_en: No tool length resetting after changing insert or cutting edge.
product_families.notes: 繁體中文名稱為整理譯名，非型錄原文。

product_families.description_en: Indexable carbide inserts for fine-hole deburring and chamfering on CNC machines.
features_en: Uses the same holder as the X060 engraving tool.
product_families.notes: 繁體中文名稱為整理譯名，非型錄原文。

product_families.description_en: Indexable chamfering and countersinking system with dual-relief angle inserts.
product_families.notes: 繁體中文名稱為整理譯名，非型錄原文。

product_families.description_en: Six-flute indexable deburring system for narrow spaces and front/back deburring.
features_en: Front and back deburring in one operation.
product_families.notes: 繁體中文名稱為整理譯名，非型錄原文。

product_families.description_en: Six-flute indexable threading system using 55° and 60° inserts.
features_en: Various MCC inserts fit on the same holder.
product_families.notes: 繁體中文名稱為整理譯名，非型錄原文。

product_families.name_zh_tw: Ergo ER 一體式錐柄刀具
product_families.description_en: Integrated ER taper-shank indexable cutter system with Ergo nut and high-strength pin clamping.
features_en: Short tool length and quick change.

series.name_en: X060 Micro Spotting, Engraving and Deburring

product_families.notes: 繁體中文名稱為整理譯名，非型錄原文。

product_families.description_en: Indexable helical interpolation tool with serrated cutting edges for swarf control.
features_en: Six tools cover holes from Ø13 to Ø65 mm.
Serrated cutting edges make chips short and small.

series.notes: Ramping angle is 9°, distinct from the 20° maximum of smaller tools.

product_families.notes: 繁體中文名稱為整理譯名，非型錄原文。

product_families.description_en: Deep-hole indexable drilling system with a patented center pilot insert.
features_en: Diameter range Ø19 to Ø40 mm.
Custom deep-hole drills up to 12xD on request.
product_families.notes: 繁體中文名稱為整理譯名，非型錄原文。

product_families.description_en: Indexable drilling system with smaller spiral chips, internal coolant and interchangeable center/peripheral insert type.
features_en: Same insert for center and periphery.
applications_en: Drilling into angled surfaces without pre-drilling
product_families.notes: 繁體中文名稱為整理譯名，非型錄原文。

product_families.description_en: Indexable milling cutter system with patented dual-relief angle inserts.
product_families.notes: 繁體中文名稱為整理譯名，非型錄原文。

product_families.description_en: Eccentric-mechanism boring tools for precision boring with interchangeable bars.
applications_en: Combined rough and finish boring with 99146

series.name_en: 99146 Quick Change High Speed EMB Boring Bar

product_families.description_en: Fine-boring units with mounting dimensions and spare parts for setting and clamping.
product_families.notes: 繁體中文名稱為整理譯名，非型錄原文。

product_families.description_en: Tool-length recorder for Swiss-type automatic lathes and CNC turning centers.
features_en: Supports datum and tool-length offset recording.
product_families.notes: 繁體中文名稱為整理譯名，非型錄原文。

product_families.name_zh_tw: Ergo 螺帽、定位銷與工具配件

features_en: T denotes the maximum overhang length.
applications_en: Extension for ACE Spot Drill, NC Spot Drill, Chamfer Mill, NC Helix Drill and Power Mill

The Nine9 X060 Engraving Tool delivers precision with a fine 0.2mm bottom width and multiple angle
options (30°, 45°, 60°, 90°). Its sharp, high-positive rake edge ensures clean, shallow engraving,
while excellent repeatability eliminates the need for tool length resetting! A single holder supports
the entire X060 insert series, making it a versatile choice for engraving plastic, aluminum, copper,
non-ferrous metals, carbon steel, cast iron, hardened steel (HRC50) and stainless steel.
Use the V045 and V060 style engravers in materials that tend to push burrs such as stainless steels
and high temp. alloys. These inserts have a 0.2mm(0.008”) radius with a very sharp cutting edge and
cut very freely. Character widths start around 0.45mm(0.017”).

Nine9 company began in 1994 and with the development of special tools, boring heads and
accessories.
The Nine9 logo was commissioned in 1999.
It comes from the Chinese characters meaning “long life and durability” – words which
aptly describe all Nine9 tools. 99 is the largest 2 digit number, indicating maximum product
endurance.
Nine9 tools whilst being “special” in the industry, are standard in our product range.
NC spot drill , super power drill , boring tool , engraving tool , i-Center ,
NC helix drill , chamfer mill, ACE spot drill and deburring mill.
Those established Nine9 as one of market leader and innovator in the cutting tool field.

Spotting Concept!
Spotting produces a shallow hole to get better hole position enabling to produce more
accurate final product. Ideally, the proper spotting angle should have larger point angle
than that of your drill, so the center of a drill shall be the first point to contact workpiece
to avoid the drill walked or moved in starting drilling.

1. From Spot diameter “d” to get drill depth “ t ”.

3. From “d” draw a horizontal line to get intersection of the line by point angle “α”.
4. From the intersection draw a vertical line to the bottom to have depth of spotting “ t ”. “ t ” is the drill depth of
the NC program.
5. The sectional view of spotting will depend on the shape of insert, NC40 and other grades of inserts have
different sectional view.
6. For chamfering, do not use tip of insert, 1mm(0.04”) minimum clearance is required for a smooth surface finish.

Center Drill
The “ i-Center ” is a trademark of Nine9,
the developer of the first indexable center drill in the world.(Patented)
Offering an indexable insert system for the 1st time, Nine9’s “i-Center ” design improves
your process performance.
P M K N
• 2 cutting flutes design same as carbide center drill for high performance speed and feed rate.
• Each insert has 2 cutting edges.
Features
High Speed, High Feed Rate
• The special ground insert and rigid holder design facilitate high performance speed and feed
rates. For example, drilling alloy steel at 6000 rpm and feed rate of 600 mm/min. (0.1 mm/rev.)
Excellent Repeatability
• The positioning repeatability of the insert is within 0.02 mm (.0008”)
in radial direction, thus ensuring conformity to any national standards.
Easy Tool Length Setting
• The axial position accuracy of the insert is 0.05 mm (.002”). It is not necessary to reset the tool
length when changing the insert or cutting edge.
Extended Tool Life
• Coolant can be supplied through the center of the holder to increase
performance and extend tool life.
• Insert geometry, grades and coating process are specifically engineered for centering applications.

This is a revolutionary new concept of engraving tools with indexable carbide insert.

Features
High Positive Rake Angle
• Very sharp edge for shallow engraving.
• Suitable for all types of materials, such as plastic, non-ferrous metal, aluminum, copper,

Multi-Side Grinding
• Full peripherally ground insert to ensure efficient repeatability.

High Speed, High Feed Rate
• Designed to run at high speed, up to 40,000 r.p.m.
• Feed rate 0.08mm (0.003”) / rev. apply to aluminum; 0.05mm (0.002”) / rev. apply to stainless steel.
• Reduces engraving cycle time!

Tip >>
The Nine9 X060 Engraving Tool delivers precision with a fine 0.2mm bottom width and multiple angle
options (30°, 45°, 60°, 90°). Its sharp, high-positive rake edge ensures clean, shallow engraving,
while excellent repeatability eliminates the need for tool length resetting! A single holder supports
the entire X060 insert series, making it a versatile choice for engraving plastic, aluminum, copper,
non-ferrous metals, carbon steel, cast iron, hardened steel (HRC50) and stainless steel.
Use the V045 and V060 style engravers in materials that tend to push burrs such as stainless steels
and high temp. alloys. These inserts have a 0.2mm(0.008”) radius with a very sharp cutting edge and
cut very freely. Character widths start around 0.45mm(0.017”).
This tool best replaces ball nose endmills. This tool is considered to be first choice for all but fine
engraving width below 0.25mm.

               The Nine9 X060 Engraving Tool delivers precision with a fine 0.2mm bottom width and multiple angle

               and high temp. alloys. These inserts have a 0.2mm(0.008”) radius with a very sharp cutting edge and

quality_issues.issue: Quick Pick適用材質圓點為向量繪圖；文字抽取沒有評等符號。
刀桿表與圖面位置交疊，預設line策略會把代碼與規格拆成片段；不可將空格視為型錄缺值。
直徑/深度圖為圖表，預設表格候選不是可直接使用的對照數列。
本頁訂製表單中的Dimension和機台欄位本來空白，應保持空白。
圖面線與表格相交或模型列表合併至單一格；需人工依視覺列重新分配。
刻字切深圖部分含圖片和刻度；表格僅涵蓋切削條件，不能從繪圖候選臆造深度數列。
多材料性能圖多為示意與數字標註；自動表格把圖表網格當欄位，未能可靠還原。
Super Drill 3xD預設只擷取13~15.5與20~24 mm兩片段，10~12.5、16~19.5、25~30 mm料號規格未形成資料表候選；需以原頁補錄。
Power Mill insert size 6.5 mm及10 mm切削參數表被合併成一張表，含中間分段標題及重複表頭；兩組參數不可混用。
部分Insert/Screw/Key欄在抽取表格範圍之外，需要以原頁的右側文字補錄。
最右Machining time列未被表格bbox完整涵蓋。
DC-6E collet的3.0/4.0 mm兩列被合併；DC Slim Chuck料號採縮寫，不可直接視為完整料號。
SI16 倒角／鑄鐵／60° 的 f 原書為 0.10 ~ 0.03。保留 raw_value，min/max 留 null，等待確認。
部分特殊字型無 Unicode 對應，文字保留 (cid:...) 記號；沒有執行 OCR 或自行猜字。
